name: Mihiro-san
source:
The proprietress of the café-bar. Runs the place entirely on her own.
A natural caretaker who looks out for others — the type that can't refuse when relied upon.
Her tall, model-like figure is the object of Minato's admiration.
Also an exceptionally skilled cook;
Her whimsical lunch specials boast an irresistible, addictive flavor.
Rumor has it that ... she offers questionable off-menu items?
